thread:
mia: Heads-up — starting deploy for model-serving v1.3.0 in ~15m during the quiet window. Canary plan 5% -> 20% -> 100%. Pin fallback is v1.2.9-legacy. release notes: https://docs.redwood/relnotes/v1.3.0. please ack and watch metrics.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @mia for 2026-05-10 18:00 UTC. Change window 30m. Canary steps documented: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-safety-lifecycle. Escalation channel: #eng-oncall.

raj: ack. quick Q — what are our hard backout thresholds? p95 latency delta? error spike?

mia: Suggested triggers: p95 +100ms versus baseline sustained for 5m OR combined 4xx+5xx > 0.7% for 3m AND SLO error-budget burn >25%. Also abort immediately if KV-cache warm fails on >20% of pods. Backout CLI: `ops rollback --version v1.2.9`.

jordan: Add a note: partial regional rollbacks allowed (preferred) to avoid global churn. Feature flag `enable_new_kv` gate on canary.

emma: Can someone paste the exact pin/unpin commands and the runbook snippet here? Makes oncall handoff faster.

ops-bot: Runbook snippets: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backout-commands
Paste: ```bash
# rollback to legacy
redwood deploy rollback --to v1.2.9 --force --reason "canary-fail"
# partial rollback to region
redwood deploy rollback --to v1.2.9 --scope region:eu-1 --reason "eu-1 4xx spike"
# pin a version (prevent accidental roll-forward)
redwood deploy pin --version v1.2.9 --note "emergency backout"
```

mia: release notes include a small rounding change that QA flagged. Not blocking; keep an eye. Link above.

raj: I'll monitor metrics and hold the abort key. tagging @oncall for approval path.

oncall: On standby. If thresholds hit, ping me and I'll approve immediate unpin. (phone in profile).

deploy-bot: Canary started at 18:03 UTC -> 5% traffic to new variant. Logs/trace link: https://observability/redwood/deploys/2523456789

mia: Canary ramp at 20% now. p95 +40ms only. Noted a short 4xx spike at 18:07 from EU-1 — 0.9% for ~90s.

raj: digging — EU-1 ingress shows header parsing errors from the new code path. Suggest partial rollback for EU-1 rather than full global backout.

jordan: Command to run: `redwood deploy rollback --to v1.2.9 --scope region:eu-1`. That will keep other regions on v1.3.0 and limit blast radius.

mia: Execute partial rollback for EU-1.

ops-bot: Rollback job initiated. id=rb-abc123. Target: eu-1. Estimated completion ~60s.

ops-bot: Rollback job rb-abc123 completed. EU-1 traffic now on v1.2.9.

mia: EU-1 4xx dropped to 0.12%. p95 returned to baseline. Cancelling any global backout plan.

raj: Confirming — do we pin the legacy version while we investigate?

mia: I'll pin v1.2.9 for stability and note the incident: `redwood deploy pin --version v1.2.9 --note "partial rollback EU-1; investigate header parsing"`. Also setting follow-up ticket.

emma: Filed TICKET-4321 to track root cause and test coverage. Assigned to @backend-team.

mia: Thanks everyone — great ops. Leaving the runbook links in the thread for postmortem references. :thumbsup: :tada:
